title: Reduce streaming token latency: token loop refactor, adaptive flush cadence, backpressure and kernel scheduling hints
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: Streaming token latency spikes were observed for short-sequence interactive workloads due to a combination of the token emission loop flush cadence, head-of-line backpressure in continuous batching, and suboptimal kernel scheduling choices when KV cache activity peaks. This PR implements a coordinated multi-layer approach to reduce 95th and 99th percentile token emission latency while preserving throughput. Changes include 1) refactor of the token emission loop to separate scheduling, flush/timer, and write paths so we can apply adaptive timers without blocking the main generation pipeline; 2) adaptive flush cadence driven by observed queue depth and downstream backpressure signals to avoid sending tiny micro-batches while still keeping latency low; 3) backpressure-aware batching: continuous batching now exposes per-request backpressure hints and can prioritize low-latency streams for immediate flush; 4) kernel scheduling hints at dispatcher level so the runtime can prefer lower-latency kernels on hot paths and prefer throughput kernels for bulk batched work; 5) KV cache prefetch + eviction tuning to reduce cache misses during token streaming; 6) new unit/integration tests and end-to-end benchmarks with synthetic and production-like traces. Motivation: customers running interactive assistant UIs and streaming generation saw token latency regression when we introduced more aggressive batching. This PR recovers and improves tail latency with modest cost impact. Checklist: - [x] Token loop refactor and unit tests - [x] Adaptive flush timer and telemetry - [x] Backpressure hint plumbing and tests - [x] Kernel scheduling hint integration - [x] KV cache heuristic improvements - [x] Benchmarks and perf dashboard updates - [x] Documentation note in changelog Related: ENG-4821 tracks overall streaming SLOs. See internal doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4821/streaming-slo-reduction for traces and perf plans.
commits: Refactor token emission loop into scheduler + emitter (modularize token_loop.rs)
Add adaptive flush cadence driven by batch depth and downstream backpressure
Expose backpressure hints from continuous-batcher to request context
Add kernel scheduling hint field to dispatcher and wire to runtime scheduler
Improve KV cache prefetch heuristics and eviction thresholds
Add end-to-end streaming latency benchmark and CI job
review_comments: Evan Li: Great decomposition of the token loop, can you justify the default adaptive timer values in comments?
Priya Nair: Added detailed comments and linked the perf doc; defaults tuned from internal traces (see bench results)
Sara Owens: Can the kernel scheduling hints be overridable per-tenant? We shouldn't force choices for Dedicated customers.
Priya Nair: Yes, dispatcher accepts per-tenant override via config; added config flag and tests.
Liam Chen: KV cache prefetch looks promising but could increase memory under high-concurrency. Did you add safeguards?
Priya Nair: Added a soft quota and an eviction acceleration when memory threshold is reached; documented behavior and added a regression test.
Evan Li: Bench results look good. Approving pending small naming nit in continuous_batcher API.
Priya Nair: Addressed naming nit and pushed fix.
release_notes: Reduced streaming token 95th/99th percentile latency by ~20-35% on interactive traces. Adds adaptive flush cadence, backpressure-aware batching, kernel scheduling hints, and KV cache tuning. No breaking changes. See changelog for details.
benchmarks_summary: E2E streaming benchmark: baseline 95th=120ms token latency, 99th=210ms. After PR: 95th=92ms (23% reduction), 99th=140ms (33% reduction). Throughput impact: ~3% qps overhead in tight batching scenarios; trade-offs documented.
notes: This PR is part of a larger effort ENG-4821 and will be followed by a Dedicated deployment toggle and a private deployment ops runbook. Ops flagged a minor rollout strategy to enable kernel-hint gating per-region.
